reason: As someone who remembers the refunds and has already given this month, A answers my doubts better: it tells me only $49,000 is left to raise, promises quarterly spending reports at the library, gives a Thanksgiving reopening date, admits it can't promise opening-week films, and is signed by a named person. B is warm but leaves out the remaining gap and the accountability, and adds a year (2027) to the deadline that the facts don't supply.
